title: Law of the Kyrgyz Republic of 7 July 2026 No. 104 on Climate Activity
citation: Law of the Kyrgyz Republic of 7 July 2026 No. 104 "On Climate Activity" (Erkin-Too no. 51 (3811) of 10 July 2026)
evidence: Article 39(1) of the text on the CBD: "Настоящий Закон вступает в силу с 1 января 2027 года." followed by "Опубликован в официальной государственной газете «Эркин Тоо» от 10 июля 2026 года № 51 (3811)". The CBD status field reads "Не вступил в силу" (not yet in force). Opened https://cbd.minjust.gov.kg/api/v1/GetEdition?editionId=57539&lang=ru on 2026-11-03.
notes: Stored from the Ministry of Justice CBD (1 edition on the site; records: ru 1, ky 1). Text is the plain text of the HTML in the JSON returned by GetEdition for each edition and language, nothing reworded; editions before about 2013 are preformatted text with the CBD's hard line breaks and hyphenation, kept as served. Adopted 2026-07-07; not yet in force on 2026-11-03, so the record is dated its in-force date, 2027-01-01. The CBD serves one edition. Article 14(2) requires large greenhouse-gas-emitting economic entities (criteria set by the Cabinet of Ministers) to give the authorised state body, free of charge, the information and data it requests for the greenhouse gas inventory; small and medium businesses take part voluntarily (art. 14(3)); the earlier register row said no private-sector duty was identified, which this text corrects. Article 39(2)(1) repeals Law No. 71 of 2007 (kg-ghg-emission-law-71) from the same date. Ministry page https://mnr.gov.kg/ is a JavaScript application whose climate documents list (https://mnr.gov.kg/ky/npas/izmeneniye-climata) did not render a link to the law for a script; the in_force date is read from the law text itself. No government English translation was found: looked for at https://cbd.minjust.gov.kg/ (interface and API serve Russian and Kyrgyz only; GetEdition with lang=en returns the Kyrgyz text), https://mnr.gov.kg/en (200, 93633 bytes, no law text linked), https://kenesh.kg/en (200, 1561 bytes, a JavaScript shell that served no content to a script), https://www.nbkr.kg/index.jsp?lang=ENG (200, 91758 bytes, no climate law) and https://minjust.gov.kg/en (403, 5663 bytes). No translation row exists.

title: Kyrgyz Stock Exchange: Guide on the preparation and publication of reports on climate, sustainable development and corporate governance (April 2025 revision)
citation: ZAO Kyrgyz Stock Exchange, Руководство по подготовке и публикации отчетов в области климата, устойчивого развития и корпоративного управления, 2025
evidence: Guide section 1.1: "В текущей версии, после пересмотра в апреле 2025 года, частично учтены недавно введённые Стандарты раскрытия информации в области устойчивого развития, разработанные Советом по международным стандартам финансовой отчётности (IFRS)." Section 1.8: "Те компании, для которых действующий Кодекс корпоративного управления Кыргызской Республики является обязательным на основе принципа «соблюдай или объясняй», обязаны применять настоящее Руководство при подготовке и публикации своих отчетов об устойчивом развитии." No page opened states a commencement date. Opened https://www.kse.kg/files/files/ESG_Guide_KSE_ru.pdf on 2026-11-03 (200 application/pdf, 1143627 bytes).
notes: Link only: the publisher kse.kg states "Копирование материалов – только с письменного разрешения" and the row KG-KSE-ADOPTED is permission requested; nothing is stored and no request has been sent. Section 1.8 makes the Guide mandatory for companies that must apply the Corporate Governance Code of the Kyrgyz Republic on a comply-or-explain basis and voluntary for all others; section 1.6 says the exchange will work from 2026 to 2028 with the state financial-market regulator and the National Bank on full adoption of the ISSB standards. The brief asked for the financial regulator's rule: the National Bank material found (roadmap, see register.csv) is a plan, and the financial-market regulator's site (fmrs.kg) did not answer from the cloud address. No government English translation was found: looked for at https://cbd.minjust.gov.kg/ (interface and API serve Russian and Kyrgyz only; GetEdition with lang=en returns the Kyrgyz text), https://mnr.gov.kg/en (200, 93633 bytes, no law text linked), https://kenesh.kg/en (200, 1561 bytes, a JavaScript shell that served no content to a script), https://www.nbkr.kg/index.jsp?lang=ENG (200, 91758 bytes, no climate law) and https://minjust.gov.kg/en (403, 5663 bytes). No translation row exists.
status_note: Binding only through the comply-or-explain Corporate Governance Code for the companies named in Guide section 1.8; otherwise voluntary.
